title: Collection Details — container feel
question: Privacy toggle moves into Details → Visibility (Settings keeps delete only). Comp A’s two-column overview currently mirrors the event hub too closely. How should Details read as a container of sessions, not a standalone event?

options.label: Membership-led overview
options.thesis: Keep quiet header + tabs. Replace the event-like About column with a container brief: description, then a short membership strip (counts + jump to Events). Cover stays, but smaller / less session-hero. Visibility card owns the Private toggle inline.
options.viewport: Details: cover | container brief + membership glance → Visibility with Private switch. Duplicate Private row in the overview goes away. Settings = danger zone only.
options.risk: Membership glance can feel duplicated with the Events tab if it lists too many rows.

options.label: Identity strip + members first
options.thesis: Drop the two-column event overview. Details opens with a compact identity band (cover thumbnail, name/desc, share, edit) then a membership preview list. Visibility with Private toggle sits after the band.
options.viewport: Horizontal identity strip → preview of contained events → Visibility switch. Events tab still owns full Add/Remove.
options.risk: Bigger departure from Comp A / event-hub grammar; more layout rewrite.

options.label: Light polish only
options.thesis: Keep Comp A layout. Only move the Private switch into Visibility, remove the duplicate Private meta in About, and retune labels/copy so it says collection/items—not session language.
options.viewport: Same two-column card. Visibility becomes interactive. Settings = delete only.
options.risk: May still feel event-like because the composition stays session-overview shaped.
